evidence.note: Implements the portable layer in profiles/motion/motion.json. The six laws, four prohibitions, seven roles and seven seams are bound in src/motion/contract.ts; the Remotion target ladder is consumed from the generated projection rather than restated. Durations collapse to one frame under reduced motion, and reduced motion is an explicit input per targets.remotion.reduced_motion.detection.
Walkthrough and QA reel render every seam and every rule beat. The QA reel is generated from the rule table, so a new rule produces a beat automatically.

gaps: Rendered motion sequences exist in the target repository but have not been ingested here as DS-scoped evidence, so this profile is not claimed as rendered
Interruption mid-flight is specified per seam but not yet captured as a recorded artifact
Reduced-motion renders exist for both films but no side-by-side comparison artifact has been recorded
No second target has implemented this profile, so the portable layer has only been projected once
